definitions.combination: First character selects latent-prefix weights; second selects focal class table.0=zero,f=fixed fitted candidate.
definitions.class_labels: 0=left lane change,1=stay,2=right lane change; not route turns.
definitions.weights: Normalize each latent point over the same survived prefix particles before crossing the focal table.
definitions.availability: Survivor-conditioned latent mass whose stored focal mask permits the native class.
definitions.all_survived_scores: Candidate score relative to stay, averaged over every survived cached prefix under the stated latent weights, including masks forbidding that class.
definitions.native_allowed_scores: Candidate score/contributions conditional on the stored mask permitting the native class; denominator is the corresponding latent mask mass.
definitions.direction_allowed_scores: left_allowed and right_allowed condition on the respective direction mask, including for stay-labelled examples; only these conditional scores are executable-direction evidence.
definitions.feature_contributions: Full38 signed/absolute contribution means remain server-side; top five ranked by absolute signed weighted mean are descriptive only.
definitions.paths: Two telescoping paths and their interaction; order dependent, not a unique causal percentage.
definitions.cohorts: Four trajectories7200s entered priors; no independent validation.1178 appears in training and diagnostics and is retained.
definitions.motion_failure: The adverse single auxiliary motion case is unresolved; this lane-change diagnostic does not remove it.
